visible.body: This kit gave me the perfect height that I wanted for my 2025 Silverado 4x4. Working on concrete with a Jack , Jack stands, and a broken back, I still completed installation in about 4 hours.

visible.author: Slegs
visible.title: Perfect leveling kit
visible.body: This is the perfect leveling kit for the 2020 Chevy Silverado RST. I looked at several different ones online all of varying heights. I decided to measure from the concrete up to my wheel well in the center of the opening. I discovered that there was only a 1.5 inch height difference between the front, and the rear. I put the kit in the truck myself this morning, and it only took me 40 minutes to do both sides. I then took the truck to my local Chevy dealership where I purchased it 2 weeks ago and ask them to check the alignment. I was amazed to discover that even my camber was still within specifications. Everything came in the box that was necessary to perform the modification. The instructions are clear, and easy to follow if you have a little bit of mechanical aptitude.
